Author: Zinochron
Name: BeastMastr
Punchline: Know your beasts and read the board at a glance.
Description:
Quality of life for Beastmaster.

Shows at a glance what each beast's actions actually do, so you can ask "which of mine interrupts?" instead of opening every entry, and puts the important facts about a Crucible of the Unbroken room next to the room itself.

Opens with /beastmastr.
